remarks:
This 5 acre property consists of woodlands located in Alma NY, Allegany County.

This nicely wooded parcel offers 300 feet of road frontage and terrain that is mostly level to gently rolling. Old roadways run throughout the property and could be easily reopened. The boundaries and corners are marked for easy walking, and electric lines run through the property near the road. Subsurface rights are not included. Remnants of former oil production remain, and the wells were properly plugged.

If you’re looking for privacy and affordability, this property is well worth considering.

Owner financing available.
